journey.name: wear restore ambient hides word
journey.description:
In ambient mode the word screen of the restore shows nothing: the field and the suggestion chips are replaced by an empty screen, and waking the watch brings the typed letters back. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, lowering the wrist or covering the screen with a palm does the same as `KEYCODE_SLEEP`).
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Backend: none, the journey stops before the wallet connects. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type `ab` into "RestoreWordInput" without pressing Enter (README › Typing, steps 2 and 3)
Verify "RestoreWordInput" reads "ab" and the chip "RestoreSuggestion-0" is listed
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP` and wait 3 s
Verify "RestoreWordInput", "RestoreProgress" and "RestoreSuggestion-0" are not listed, and `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "RestoreHidden" (README: `android layout` leaves out a node with no text)
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP` and wait 2 s
Verify "RestoreWordInput" reads "ab" again, "RestoreSuggestion-0" is listed and "RestoreHidden" is not
